name: Comparative adjectives
summary: Ikkita narsa yoki odamni bir-biridan solishtirish uchun qiyosiy sifatlardan foydalanamiz. Ular sifatga -er qo'shimchasi yoki oldiga 'more' so'zini qo'shish orqali yasaladi.

example.en: My house is bigger than yours.

usage.text: Ikki yoki undan ortiq bo'g'inli sifatlar oldidan 'more' so'zi ishlatiladi.

example.en: This test is more difficult than the last one.
An elephant is stronger than a horse.

usage.text: Farqni kuchaytirish uchun qiyosiy sifatdan oldin 'much' so'zi ishlatiladi.

example.en: Physics is much harder than history.

structure.formula: Subject + be + adjective-er / more + adjective + than + noun/pronoun
Subject + be + not + as + adjective + as + noun/pronoun

example.en: Samarkand is not as big as Tashkent.

structure.formula: Be + subject + adjective-er / more + adjective + than + noun/pronoun?

tip: Y - bilan tugaydigan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlarda (masalan: happy) y harfi tushib qoladi va -ier qo'shiladi (happier).

name: Superlative adjectives
summary: Uch yoki undan ortiq narsa va odamlardan eng ustun bo'lganini ko'rsatish uchun orttirma darajadagi sifatlardan foydalanamiz. Ular oldidan doimo 'the' artikli ishlatiladi.

usage.text: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarga 'the' va '-est' qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi.

example.en: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
example.uz: Everest cho'qqisi dunyodagi eng baland tog'.

usage.text: Uzun sifatlar oldidan 'the most' so'zi ishlatiladi.

example.en: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
example.uz: Bu men o'qigan eng qiziqarli kitob.

usage.text: Guruh ichidan ajratib ko'rsatishda 'in' yoki 'of' ko'makchulari ishlatiladi.

example.en: He is the tallest boy in the class.
example.uz: U sinfdagi eng uzun bo'yli bola.

structure.formula: Subject + be + the + adjective-est / most + adjective + in/of + group

example.en: She is the smartest student in our school.

structure.formula: Subject + be + not + the + adjective-est / most + adjective

example.en: He is not the oldest person in the room.
example.uz: U xonadagi eng yoshi ulug' odam emas.

structure.formula: Be + subject + the + adjective-est / most + adjective + in/of + group?

example.en: Who is the tallest person in your family?
example.uz: Oilangizdagi eng uzun bo'yli odam kim?

tip: Orttirma darajadagi sifatlardan oldin har doim 'the' artiklini yozishni unutmang!

name: too + adjective; adjective + enough; enough + noun
summary: Bu qoliplar me'yordan ortiqlikni ('too') yoki yetarlilikni ('enough') bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Ular gapda darajani ko'rsatadi.

usage.text: 'Too' so'zi sifatdan oldin kelib, 'haddan tashqari ko'p, salbiy ma'noda yetarli emas' degan ma'noni beradi.

example.en: This tea is too hot to drink.
example.uz: Bu choy ichish uchun juda issiq (haddan tashqari issiq).

usage.text: 'Enough' so'zi sifatdan keyin kelib, 'yetarlicha' ekanligini bildiradi.
'Enough' so'zi otlardan oldin kelib, narsaning miqdori yetarli ekanini bildiradi.

example.en: We have enough time to finish the project.
example.uz: Loyihani tugatish uchun yetarli vaqtibmiz bor.

example.en: The box is too heavy to lift.
He is old enough to drive a car.
example.uz: U mashina haydash uchun yetarlicha yoshga yetgan.

example.en: I have enough money to buy a phone.
example.uz: Menda telefon sotib olish uchun yetarli pul bor.

tip: Joylashuviga e'tibor bering: 'too' sifatdan OLDIN, 'enough' esa sifatdan KEYIN, lekin otning OLDINDA keladi.
